# Functional unit

The functional unit is the quantified performance of a product system for use as a
reference unit. In ILCD terms it names what the system delivers, how much, how well and
for how long. (source: ilcd-2010)

All inputs and outputs of the inventory are scaled to it, which is what makes two
systems comparable.
